ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Trailbook uses your camera so you can capture waypoint photos during recording.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Trailbook uses your photos so you can attach images to route waypoints.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Trailbook uses your location to show where you are and support trip recording.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Trailbook uses your location to keep recording trips when the app is in the background or the screen is locked.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Trailbook uses your location to keep recording trips when the app is in the background or the screen is locked.
ios.NSMotionUsageDescription: Trailbook uses motion activity to distinguish walking, cycling, and driving more reliably in auto mode.
